The '''GR-45 medium transport''' was a civilian-use model of [[transport]] [[Starship|ship]] manufactured by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc.|Gallofree Yards]]. As a member of the [[GR-series]], it had the same hull shape<ref name="BMF 20" /> as the [[GR-75 medium transport]], another Gallofree Yards product.<ref name="UltimateSW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], one such ship was parked illegally on the [[Outer Curved Street]] in [[Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine]]. On their way to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] passed by this transport, alongside teams of [[ASP-7 labor droid|ASP-7 labor droids]] loading it.<ref name="CL 2016" />
